Container.Name: Tellybox
Container.Overview: Lets young kids pick parent-approved videos on any phone or tablet and plays them on the TV through a Chromecast, within a daily time allowance. You approve every video, and the kids' screen works without reading. Needs host networking so it can find the Chromecast. First run: open the WebUI, go to /admin/setup and enter the setup code from the container log. Run only one Tellybox per Chromecast.

Config.Name: Data
Config.Description: Database, signing key and the self-updating yt-dlp install.

Config.Name: Media
Config.Description: Downloaded episodes, thumbnails and show artwork (about 0.5 to 1 GB per hour of video).

Config.Name: Time zone
Config.Description: Your time zone. The daily reset (04:00) and the history use it.

Config.Name: Web port
Config.Description: Port of the kid app (/) and the admin pages (/admin). With host networking, change it here if the port is taken.

Config.Name: Cast API port
Config.Description: Internal API, localhost only. Change it if the port is taken.

Config.Name: PUID
Config.Description: User id the services run as (Unraid: 99 = nobody).

Config.Name: PGID
Config.Description: Group id the services run as (Unraid: 100 = users).

Config.Name: Media base URL
Config.Description: Optional. Only if autodetection picks the wrong network interface: how the Chromecast reaches the server, for example http://192.168.1.10:8080

Config.Name: Admin password
Config.Description: Optional. Leave empty to choose the password in the browser, with the setup code from the container log.

Config.Name: OIDC issuer
Config.Description: Optional: sign in to the admin with an OpenID Connect provider too; the password stays. The provider's issuer URL, for example https://id.example.org. Then the client id, redirect URI and admin group are needed too.

Config.Name: OIDC client id
Config.Description: Optional (OIDC): the client id from the provider.

Config.Name: OIDC client secret
Config.Description: Optional (OIDC): the client secret. Leave empty for a public client.

Config.Name: OIDC redirect URI
Config.Description: Optional (OIDC): your Tellybox address followed by /admin/oidc/callback, for example https://tellybox.example.org/admin/oidc/callback, exactly as registered at the provider.

Config.Name: OIDC admin group
Config.Description: Optional (OIDC): only members of this group may use the admin pages.

Config.Name: OIDC groups claim
Config.Description: Optional (OIDC): the claim holding the user's groups. Empty means groups.

Config.Name: OIDC scopes
Config.Description: Optional (OIDC): scopes to request. Empty means openid profile email groups.
